title: Positive Environment at Children’s Homes, Shelters and Other Welfare Homes
what_it_is: Positive Environment at Children’s Homes, Shelters and Other Welfare Homes

sections.label: Education for children in homes
sections.summary: Schools give all students equal access to good quality education, and community case managers work with schools so children in children's homes keep attending school.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Our schools provide equal opportunities for all students, regardless of background, to access good quality education.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development aims to minimise disruption to the educational needs of such children, even though circumstances had led them to be separated from their own families.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For example, community case managers in the children’s homes work with the schools to ensure that the children continue to attend school.

sections.label: Children and youths in homes
sections.summary: Shelters and welfare homes serve adults, and the number of children and youths in these homes fell from about 798 in 2015 to 701 in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Shelters are intended for adults who have exhausted all other means of accommodation or those who face family violence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Welfare homes do not admit children, and serve only adults who are destitute.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: All I can say is that the numbers of children and youths in these homes have been going down.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In 2015, we had about 798 children; in 2016, it went down to 734; in 2017, it was 701.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: This is because we are looking at transforming the out-of-home care sector.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are putting more kids into foster families.
